mapper.select:
SELECT id, media_id, season_id, title, type, season_type_name, cover, square_cover, horizontal_cover, total_count, is_finish, index_show, score, evaluate, url, badge, areas, view_count, follow_count, updated_at, created_at FROM bangumis
AND season_type_name = #{seasonTypeName}
AND (title LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR evaluate LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%'))
ORDER BY score DESC, follow_count DESC
ORDER BY total_count DESC, score DESC
ORDER BY updated_at DESC
ORDER BY score DESC, follow_count DESC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO bangumis (media_id, season_id, title, type, season_type_name, cover, square_cover, horizontal_cover, total_count, is_finish, index_show, score, evaluate, url, badge, areas, view_count, follow_count, updated_at, created_at) VALUES (#{mediaId}, #{seasonId}, #{title}, #{type}, #{seasonTypeName}, #{cover}, #{squareCover}, #{horizontalCover}, #{totalCount}, #{isFinish}, #{indexShow}, #{score}, #{evaluate}, #{url}, #{badge}, #{areas}, #{viewCount}, #{followCount}, NOW(), NOW()) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE title = VALUES(title), type = VALUES(type), season_type_name = VALUES(season_type_name), cover = VALUES(cover), square_cover = VALUES(square_cover), horizontal_cover = VALUES(horizontal_cover), total_count = VALUES(total_count), is_finish = VALUES(is_finish), index_show = VALUES(index_show), score = VALUES(score), evaluate = VALUES(evaluate), url = VALUES(url), badge = VALUES(badge), areas = VALUES(areas), view_count = VALUES(view_count), follow_count = VALUES(follow_count), updated_at = NOW()
mapper.select: SELECT season_type_name AS name, COUNT(*) AS count FROM bangumis GROUP BY season_type_name ORDER BY count DESC
SELECT ROUND(AVG(score), 1) FROM bangumis WHERE score > 0
